analysis.root_cause: The supplied records indicate a decline due to insufficient customer funds.
evidence: Internal status is FAILED with error code INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS and description 'Insufficient customer balance'.
MockGateway returned status DECLINED, response code 51, and message 'Insufficient funds'.
Internal and gateway records agree on the reason for failure.
recommended_actions: Inform the customer that the payment was declined due to insufficient funds.
Ask the customer to ensure sufficient funds are available or use an alternative payment method.
analysis.retry_recommendation: Do not retry automatically without an approved business rule. A customer-initiated retry may be appropriate after sufficient funds are available.
